rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for elegant movement, appearance, or proportions.

example.english: Their dancing posture is very graceful.
example.jyutping: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 zi1 sai3 hou2 jau1 ngaa5

rows.note: Use this for accepting a setback without bitterness or arrogance, rather than for physical elegance.

example.english: You are still so graceful about losing the game; that is really admirable.
example.traditional: 你輸咗場波仲咁大方，真係難得。
example.jyutping: nei5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1 zung6 gam3 daai6 fong1 zan1 hai6 naan4 dak1
